verified_claims.claim: KM32 实现约 50% taxadiene 提升，并在 BioLector 中达到 215 mg/L
verified_claims.source_locator: 正文第 4 页（Introduction 末段）
verified_claims.evidence: We achieved a 50% increase in taxadiene yield compared to the parent strain when four reactions were upregulated by integrating an extra copy of ILV2, TRR1, ADE13 and ECM31 genes driven by a galactose-inducible promoter. Using a micro-scale high-throughput bioreactor platform, i.e. BioLector, we achieved the detection of 215 mg/L of taxadiene

verified_claims.claim: KM32 产出 T5α-ol 43.65 mg/L 与 T5αAc 26.2 mg/L 为酿酒酵母早期前体最高滴度
verified_claims.evidence: KM32 produced the highest reported yields of taxa-4(20),11-dien-5α-ol (T5α-ol) at 43.65 mg/L and taxa-4(20),11-dien-5-α-yl acetate (T5αAc) at 26.2 mg/L among early-step Taxol® metabolites in S. cerevisiae

verified_claims.claim: 此前酿酒酵母 taxadiene 报道最高值为 137 mg/L
verified_claims.evidence: approximately 1.6-fold higher production was achieved than the previously reported maximum, which was 137 mg/L in S. cerevisiae cell factories [23]

verified_claims.claim: 250 mL 生物反应器第 120 h 滴度：taxadiene 236.7 mg/L、T5α-ol 47.1 mg/L、T5αAc 31.2 mg/L
verified_claims.evidence: These reached to 236.7, 47.1 and 31.2 mg/L, respectively on the fifth day (Fig. 9B)

verified_claims.claim: Yeast GEM 8.5.0 含 4055 反应、2742 代谢物、1151 基因、14 区室
verified_claims.evidence: yeast 8.5.0 comprises 4055 reactions, 2742 metabolites, and 1151 genes in 14 cellular compartments [28]

verified_claims.claim: 17 个候选：9 敲除 + 8 过表达
verified_claims.source_locator: 正文第 1 页 Abstract + Table 1（p8）
verified_claims.evidence: We screened 17 genomic modifications, including nine gene deletions and eight gene overexpressions

verified_claims.claim: KMRJ19（DTR1Δ）产出全研究最高 GGOH 221 mg/L；KMRJ31（OAR1Δ + DTR1Δ）取得 128 mg/L taxadiene
verified_claims.evidence: KMRJ19 with DTR1 deletion produced the highest GGOH with 221 mg/L among all the strains used in this study; The combination of OAR1Δ and DTR1Δ in KMRJ31 resulted in the maximum taxadiene production of 128 mg/L
